https://github.com/fblissjr/LTX-2/tree/audio-guidance-iclora-vtv

nodes.title: Audio IC-LoRA strength
widgets_values:
**Start at ~0.5 strength.**

Pushing toward 1.0 drives the audio attention off-distribution and the output garbles; the usable band is ~0.3-0.75 and the ceiling is content/seed-dependent. Back off if it breaks up.

In a medium shot at a dim restaurant table, an animated man leans in, grinning, and says, "you wanna hear something unbelievable? I told him a hundred times, do not get in that car." He laughs, gesturing wide, "like I'm talking to a brick wall here." He jabs a thumb at his own chest, "me, I'm the one looking out for him." He shrugs, "and he gets in anyway, this genius." His voice starts climbing, "so I say it again, you really trust that guy?" He cocks his head, "that guy?" His voice cracks, incredulous, "after everything?!" He leans back, spreading his arms, "and now somehow I'm the bad guy here." His tone hardens, low, "unbelievable. some people." American accent, tense and animated delivery, close intimate restaurant ambience.

nodes.title: Models (filename -> what it is)
widgets_values:
## Models (filename -> what it is)

**Transformer (UNETLoader):** `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_transformer_only_fp8_scaled.safetensors`
LTX-2.3 **22B distilled** transformer, fp8-scaled. -> `models/diffusion_models`. Distilled => runs at **CFG 1** (strength is the only guidance knob).

**Text encoder (DualCLIPLoader):** `gemma_3_12B_it_fpmixed.safetensors` + `ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors`
Gemma-3 12B encoder + LTX text projection. -> `models/text_encoders`, type `ltxv`.

**VAEs (VAELoaderKJ x2):** `LTX2_video_vae_bf16.safetensors` (video, bf16) + `LTX2_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors` (audio: ComfyUI forces fp32 regardless of the dtype widget, matching the fp32 training encode). -> `models/vae`.

Swap in your own filenames if they differ. LoRA download is in "Downloads & setup".

nodes.title: Sage Attention (optional, off by default)
widgets_values:
## Sage Attention (optional, off by default)

This **AudioLoopHelper Sage** node is **bypassed** by default and was tuned on a 4090 (sm89). SageAttention is an optional speedup, not required to run this workflow.

If you want it, the simplest general path is **KJNodes' "Patch Sage Attention" (PatchSageAttentionKJ)** node on the model line (or their **LTX2 Mem-Efficient Sage** patch for LTX-2 specifically).

If you do enable this node: mode `auto_mask_aware` (safe), fallback_on_error on, skip_under_seq_len 1024.

nodes.title: Audio IC-LoRA Loader (per-stream)
widgets_values:
## Audio IC-LoRA Loader (per-stream)

Loads the audio IC-LoRA with a separate dial per stream:

- **audio_strength** (band 0.3-0.75, start ~0.5): the audio modules (voice -> voice). The main dial.
- **bridge_strength** (0 to ~1.0, ~0.8): the cross-modal bridge (voice -> on-screen face/motion). Push *above* audio_strength to amplify the picture's response; >1.0 extrapolates and smears. **No-op for the audio-only checkpoint** (no bridge).

Fails loud if the LoRA binds nothing (wrong base model) — watch the console.

nodes.title: Audio IC-LoRA Loader (basic) — bypassed
widgets_values:
## Audio IC-LoRA Loader (basic)

**Bypassed by default.** Single-strength alternative to the per-stream loader: **strength_model** ~0.5 (band 0.3-0.75) applied to all LoRA modules. Use it if you don't need the separate bridge dial. To switch: un-bypass this, bypass the per-stream loader.

nodes.title: Add Audio IC-LoRA Guide (Advanced)
widgets_values:
## Add Audio IC-LoRA Guide (Advanced)

Attaches the **audio-only** reference (encoded by the audio VAE) as context tokens at negative RoPE positions. No image/video reference.

- **reference_window_sec** (0 = whole clip; ~3.5 matches training): trims the reference to its first N seconds. A full song is longer than anything seen in training; ~3.5-5s is the sweet spot.
- **reference_scale** (1.0 default, max 4.0; sweep ~0.5-2.0): scales the encoded reference magnitude. Far from 1.0 goes off-distribution.

Keep the caption neutral so the *audio* drives the attribute. (For energy-based window selection, use the **Compose Reference Audio** node's *Auto-find hook* button.)

## Keyframe-driven i2v + Audio IC-LoRA (single pass)

Forked from `audio-ic-lora_single-pass.json`. Keyframe images drive the PICTURE; the audio IC-LoRA reference steers AUDIO attributes; the model generates audio+video jointly in one distilled 8-step pass.

### Wiring (the splice)
- **Latent:** `EmptyLTXVLatentVideo` -> **KeyframeGuidesTimeSpaced** -> `LTXVConcatAVLatent.video_latent`. The keyframe node appends guide frames to the VIDEO-ONLY latent (core `append_keyframe` rejects a combined AV latent), so it sits BEFORE the AV concat.
- **Conditioning:** `LTXVConditioning` -> **KeyframeGuidesTimeSpaced** -> `LTXAddAudioICLoRAGuideAdvanced` -> `CFGGuider`. Keyframe node stamps `keyframe_idxs`; audio guide stamps `ref_audio` — orthogonal keys, no collision.
- **Decode:** sampler -> `LTXVSeparateAVLatent` -> **LTXVCropGuides** -> video decode. Crops the appended keyframe guide-frames off the video latent tail (operates on the separated single-stream video latent).

### Keyframe source
`VHS_LoadVideo` at **force_rate=1** = one keyframe/second. `seconds_per_keyframe=1.0`, `output_fps=25` (matches `LTXVConditioning.frame_rate`). Keyframe[0] at frame 0 = the i2v init; later keyframes interpolate. Size `EmptyLTXVLatentVideo.length` for the clip; keyframes past the latent end are dropped (see `placement_info`).

### COMPOSITION RISK — UNVERIFIED ON GPU
Structurally the keyframe-guide and audio-IC-LoRA mechanisms touch DISJOINT state: the keyframe node grows the video latent + stamps `keyframe_idxs`; the audio guide only attaches `ref_audio` tokens and never touches the latent. They merge on the conditioning dict without key collision, and `LTXVConcatAVLatent` keeps video/audio as independent NestedTensor streams (so a guide-extended video stream is shape-legal).

What is NOT verifiable without a render: whether the MODEL attends coherently to BOTH the keyframe guide frames (which carry their own RoPE positions via `keyframe_idxs`) AND the audio `ref_audio` tokens in the SAME forward pass on the distilled CFG=1 base. The audio IC-LoRA was trained on a no-keyframe path; keyframe anchoring may compete with the audio reference for cross-attention budget, or the guide-frame RoPE offsets may interact with the audio token positions. **Test on GPU: start with strength=1.0 keyframes + a short clip; if audio attributes wash out, lower keyframe `strength`; if the picture ignores keyframes, the paths likely don't co-attend and this needs a model-side change.**
